source_clause: ICE6.) Fan ranges: Off, 1-7 (denoting to show AUTO label instead when in AUTO). The status is indicated on TS climate screen and in main category control. Show pop-up when status is changed via hard control and currently shown screen is not climate screen. When on climate screen, user can either use Fan up/down buttons, directly touch a fan segment to jump or slide, or use Hard Control. The user shall not be able to turn the FAN off by using the FAN controls on the screen or the FAN hard control. There would always be one bar highlighted. The only way to have all FAN bars grayed out is by shutting the CLIMATE system OFF (using climate power button on the screen or hard control).
reasoning: 驗證目標：16.7（ICE6）定出 ICS 介面之風速值域、狀態呈現位置、硬鍵 popup 條件、三種畫面調整途徑、以及不可由控制關閉風扇，五個 037 leaf 對應之，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：EMEA 軸取正向值（16.2，R-C29）；依 **R-C34** 第十三軸全數補，第九軸補 `-01`／`-02`／`-04`／`-05`（可觀察量在 climate screen 與 main category control），`-03`（popup）不補，第十二軸不補。為什麼這樣切：`-05` 之「不可關閉」與「唯一全灰途徑為關閉 CLIMATE」為同一 leaf 之兩面，037 未拆，故合為一條並以兩組步驟涵蓋其正反兩側（§7 之 supported 配 negative）。刻意略過：**鏡射表反向使用之關鍵差異** —— C6 之值域為「Off, 1-7, **15h** (denoting to show AUTO instead)」而 **ICE6 無 `15h`**，其措辭為「Off, 1-7 (denoting to show AUTO **label** instead **when in AUTO**)」；`15h` 為 CAN 值，**不得自 ch2 移植**，故 `-01` 之 ER 述 AUTO 標示而不述 15h（§8.2.1）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: ICS climate screen 之風速格、main category control、fan popup
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **不適用（反向）** —— 取正向軸值 PC，出處 16.2

tcs.tc_title: Fan range runs Off to 7 and shows AUTO when in AUTO
tcs.test_item: Fan ranges shall be Off, 1-7, denoting to show the AUTO label instead when in AUTO
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Adjust the fan speed across its whole range on the climate screen
2. Turn AUTO on
tcs.expected_result:
1. The fan speeds available are 1 to 7
2. The fan speed indicator shows the AUTO label instead of a fan speed
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)

tcs.tc_title: Fan status shows on the screen and category control
tcs.test_item: The fan status shall be indicated on the TS climate screen and in the main category control
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the climate screen
2. Change the fan speed on the climate screen
3. Read the main category control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the current fan speed
2. The climate screen shows the new fan speed
3. The main category control shows the new fan speed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Fan pop-up appears off the climate screen
tcs.test_item: The system shall show a pop-up when the status is changed via hard control and the currently shown screen is not the climate screen
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open a screen other than the climate screen
2. Change the fan speed using the fan speed hard control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen is not displayed
2. A fan speed pop-up is shown
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Fan is adjustable by buttons touch or slide on screen
tcs.test_item: When on the climate screen, the user shall be able to use the Fan up/down buttons, directly touch a fan segment to jump, or slide, or use the Hard Control
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the fan up button on the climate screen
2. Touch a fan segment on the climate screen
3. Slide across the fan segments on the climate screen
4. Change the fan speed using the fan speed hard control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The fan speed increases
2. The fan speed jumps to the touched segment
3. The fan speed follows the slide
4. The fan speed follows the hard control
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Fan cannot be turned off except by the climate system
tcs.test_item: The user shall not be able to turn the FAN off by using the FAN controls on the screen or the FAN hard control, and the only way to have all FAN bars grayed out shall be by shutting the CLIMATE system OFF
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the fan down button on the climate screen repeatedly until the fan speed stops decreasing
2. Turn the fan speed hard control down repeatedly until the fan speed stops decreasing
3. Turn the climate system off using the climate power button on the screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The fan is not off and one fan bar remains highlighted
2. The fan is not off and one fan bar remains highlighted
3. All FAN bars are grayed out
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
